# Ordered lists reference

Covers Markdown starting markers, mixed nesting, all five numeric formats and
bullet format, base/item levels, geometry and empty lists. Explicit start takes
precedence over a source marker. Only the first item's valid numeric-dot marker
supplies the implicit start; an unrelated marker defaults to one. The capture
reported an unsupported-marker warning for that unrelated marker.

Ordered containers default to a fresh instance, including an explicit start-one
override. Their declared format controls marker formatting without changing the
container kind. Word numbering contains editable counters, not inserted label text.
All package parts and the evaluated model are compared; Word review is unreviewed.
